what: Curvature hatching from the SDF Hessian (web/shaders/hatch/): GPU ray march and shading against the float64 CPU reference, and the falsification tests
source: fixtures/stilllife.mjs, an owned SDF still life (torus, sphere, capsule, rounded box, ground)

tests.cylinder_curvatures: max 1/r within 2 percent, min within 0.02/r of 0
tests.torus_saddle_signs: inner equator: principal curvatures of opposite sign

rules: No criterion uses a measured display reading or calibrate-pro (author, 2026-10-10). Colour checks are in software against float64 references.
why: Ray marching in f32 and f64 differs at silhouettes and grazing hits, where a pixel can hit a different surface; elsewhere differences are rounding. The bound is a fraction of values.
